notes: New plugins target Plugin API 1.16.0; Plugin API 1.10-1.15 packages remain loadable.
Plugin API 1.16 makes safe workspace overflow and ScientificPlot geometry recovery Core-owned defaults. A plugin must not silently clip semantic UI.
SDK validation rejects Core-owned shell selectors, semantic overflow:hidden/clip, viewport-height ownership, and positive-pixel minmax(...,1fr) workspace rows.
ScientificCurveSurface minWidth/minHeight are preferred geometry, not a silent-render gate; Core may recover a minimum plot height and PluginWorkspace supplies overflow safety.
Tool/TOP workspaces use one reusable dedicated window contract with Core-owned import, theme, viewport, navigation and status-bar geometry.
The SDK is standalone and does not require DK Data Studio source code.
